67’S PRISON RUN! (Obby)

👍 LIKE & ⭐ FAVORITE the game to support more updates!

🚨 Join our group “money printer…” for FREE morphs and special rewards!

Oh no! You’ve been locked up in 67’s chaotic prison — and things are not normal here!
Run, jump, and dodge through 25 wild stages filled with traps, lasers, and surprises as you try to escape 67’s madness.
Can you survive the chaos and make it to freedom before 67 catches you saying “six-seven”? 💨

👮 Bring your friends and see who can escape the fastest!
